data.name: Bansilal
data.gender_notes: Bansilal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bansilal is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘banas’ meaning ‘banana tree’ and ‘ilal’ meaning ‘God of Fortune’. This name is a reverence to Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted as sitting under a banana tree. The name Bansilal carries the meaning “Banana Tree, God of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bansilal usually hope their child will grow to embody banana tree, god of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes prosperity and divine blessings.
data.etymology: Bansilal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Banana Tree, God of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bansilal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
